newsitem.title: USA: Optimax Inds to establish a subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Optimax Inds to establish a subsidiary.

text.p: Optimax Industries Inc said it established a new, wholly-owned subsidiary, Opti-Flowers Inc, that will import fresh-cut flowers and floral bouquets for primary distribution to mass merchandisers, food service operators and supermarket chains.

President and Chief Executive Officer David Dube said he expects "the timing of (the) new subsidiary's operations will greatly expand its customer base at the same time as it continues to build a sales and marketing infrastructure."

The company believes its initial capital requirements for the new subsidiary will amount to approximately $250,000, which it plans to fund with a combination of existing cash, the issuance of promissory notes and trade debt financing.
Optimax Industries is a manufacturing holding company with interests in the horticultural, giftware and specialty truck parts industries.
